BackstoryDef.title: street pickpocket
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] started lifting purses before [PAWN_pronoun] could read. Not out of hunger, exactly, though that was part of it, but because [PAWN_pronoun] was good at it, and being good at something in a city like that was not nothing. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to watch people before touching them, to read a mark's attention and their exits at the same time. The Guild noticed eventually. They always do.

BackstoryDef.title: city urchin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the back alleys of a merchant city, sleeping in doorways and learning which guards took bribes and which ones did not. [PAWN_pronoun] ran errands for the local fence long before [PAWN_pronoun] understood what [PAWN_pronoun] was carrying. By the time [PAWN_pronoun] did understand, [PAWN_pronoun] had already decided it was fine.

BackstoryDef.title: guild cutpurse
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has been working Guild jobs for years: lifting goods from warehouses, running items across checkpoints, and occasionally persuading someone that their valuables were better off somewhere else. [PAWN_pronoun] does not carry a weapon most of the time, which does not mean [PAWN_pronoun] cannot use one. The Guild prefers jobs that do not leave bodies, and [PAWN_nameDef] has found that preferable as well.

BackstoryDef.title: guild operative
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] handles the jobs that require more planning than a swift hand. Reconnaissance, bribery, coordinated entry, extraction under pressure. [PAWN_pronoun] has worked with enough incompetent partners to value working alone when possible and has enough scar tissue to know the difference between a job going badly and a job going to plan while everyone panics. The Guildmaster trusts [PAWN_objective] with sensitive contracts.

BackstoryDef.title: master thief
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has stolen things that were not supposed to be stealable and fenced them to people who were not supposed to know they existed. [PAWN_pronoun] spent years building a reputation and the last few protecting it, which is harder. The Guild uses [PAWN_possessive] name to put nervous clients at ease and occasionally to frighten them. Both effects are deliberate.

BackstoryDef.title: beggar runner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] begged on the city's busiest corner and passed what [PAWN_pronoun] heard to the guild. Rumors were worth more than coins, and the guild paid in both.

BackstoryDef.title: dock rat
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on the docks, slipping cargo off ships and selling it back to their captains. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to swim, to lie and to run, mostly in that order.

BackstoryDef.title: guild burglar
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] goes in through windows the owners thought were too high to reach. [PAWN_pronoun] can open most locks with a bent pin and has never taken anything that could not be sold within a week.

BackstoryDef.title: guild fence
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] buys what the guild steals and finds someone to sell it to. [PAWN_pronoun] knows what everything is worth to the copper, and pays about half of that.

BackstoryDef.title: smuggler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] moved skooma, moon sugar and untaxed wine along the coast for the guild. [PAWN_pronoun] knows every hidden cove from Anvil to Solitude and which customs officers drink.
